name: JoAi: Update Document

description.en: Update the title, content, metadata, or public share state of an existing document. Set public=true to create a shareable link (returned as url), or public=false to revoke it.
description.de: Titel, Inhalt, Metadaten oder öffentliche Freigabe eines bestehenden Dokuments aktualisieren. Mit public=true entsteht ein teilbarer Link (als url), mit public=false wird er widerrufen.
description.es: Update the title, content, metadata, or public share state of an existing document. Set public=true to create a shareable link (returned as url), or public=false to revoke it.
description.fr: Update the title, content, metadata, or public share state of an existing document. Set public=true to create a shareable link (returned as url), or public=false to revoke it.
description.ro: Update the title, content, metadata, or public share state of an existing document. Set public=true to create a shareable link (returned as url), or public=false to revoke it.
description.it: Update the title, content, metadata, or public share state of an existing document. Set public=true to create a shareable link (returned as url), or public=false to revoke it.

bot: Use this when the user wants to edit an existing document or template, correct stored information, or share/unshare a document via a public link. When public=true, return the url from the response so the user can share it (e.g. WhatsApp).

description.ro: The ID of the document to update
